Name: Huldah, the Prophetess
Summary: Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum keeper of the wardrobe, answered Josiah's messengers that evil would come on Jerusalem for forsaking the LORD, but because Josiah's heart was tender and he humbled himself, he would be gathered to his grave in peace and not see the evil.
KeyStory: Huldah declared, 'Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God... I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.'
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Shallum, Son of Tikvath
LifeLesson: A tender, humbled heart can win peace even when judgment is certain.
